title: Discover CodeVista and enter the workspace
purpose: Show public product information and offer the appropriate GitHub or workspace entry without exposing repository data.

coverage.scope: Public root/Home routing and session-dependent entry links. OAuth and workspace internals are separate processes.

nodes.title: Open the root or Home
nodes.description: Visit the empty/root hash or explicit /home hash.

nodes.title: Is this the signed-in root?
nodes.description: Only the signed-in root defaults to Projects. Explicit Home stays public for all visitors.

nodes.title: Enter Projects
nodes.description: Render the authenticated workspace after session verification.

nodes.title: Show public landing
nodes.description: Render product overview, supplied brand mark, workflow explanation, GitHub and deployment links. Do not fetch repository lists or display example flows.

nodes.title: Which session state is available?
nodes.description: Session refresh proceeds independently. Rendering updates as the session changes.

nodes.title: Offer Connect GitHub
nodes.description: Link to /auth/github. OAuth continues in the GitHub sign-in process.

nodes.title: Offer workspace navigation
nodes.description: Link to /projects. For an unconfigured anonymous host, also explain GitHub App setup. Before session resolves, offer workspace navigation; on session failure keep public content visible and offer Retry connection to reload.

edges.label: Signed-in root
edges.condition: Root route and session has a user

edges.label: Public home
edges.condition: Explicit Home route or root without a resolved user

edges.label: Connect GitHub
edges.condition: Resolved anonymous session and host configured

edges.label: Open workspace
edges.condition: Signed-in session, unresolved or failed session, or host unconfigured
